system.description:
This skill only produces an effect when you have at least one empty [Hand Slot]. You may reduce the [Hate] cost for «Spell Maximize» «Death Cloud» by -1 (minimum 0).

(SR2): During Preplay, select one [Magic Attack] skill you know. Until the end of the scenario, that skill's [Hate] cost is reduced by -1 (minimum 0).

A combat style that omits the chanting of magic by cutting the curse mark with one free hand.
